plan: Second-price auction with independent private values. Dominant strategy: bid your true value. Overbidding risks winning at a price above value; underbidding risks losing when winning would be profitable. With value = 39 and no history to exploit (single round), bid 39 to maximize expected profit. Ties resolve randomly; no benefit to shading given uniform draws and unknown opponents.

Second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values: the dominant strategy is to bid my true value to maximize expected profit. There’s only one round and no history to exploit, so no strategic shading or signaling helps. With value $20, bidding 20 wins whenever rivals’ top bid is below 20 and pays the second-highest bid, guaranteeing nonnegative profit when winning and zero otherwise. This maximizes long-run expected profit under these rules.

[ In a second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values, the weakly dominant strategy is to bid your true value.
